### Quick links - check before posting

### Describe the problem
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.  
Less is more; so brief description which gets to the point is very appreciated (un-edited AI dumps are not).

### Hardware setup
Wiring diagram, schematic, pictures etc.

### Additional info
 - Wireless module type [e.g. CC1101, SX1268, etc.]
 - Library version [e.g. 8.0.0 or git hash]
 - Microcontroller: [e.g. Arduino Uno, ESP8266 etc.]
 - Software platform information [e.g. Arduino IDE version, ESP-IDF version etc.]
